subject: evs
prompt_en: Why do we need protective foods like fruits and vegetables, even though they don't give much energy?
prompt_hi: Phal aur sabziyan zyada energy nahi deti, phir bhi hume inki zaroorat kyon hai?
answer: They have vitamins and minerals that keep body parts working and help fight illness, and fibre that helps digestion.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Compare two snacks: a bowl of roasted chana with an apple, and a packet of chips with a cold drink. Both taste good. Which helps your body more, and why?
prompt_hi: Do snack ki tulna karo: bhune chane ki katori ke saath ek seb, aur chips ka packet ke saath cold drink. Dono swaadisht hain. Body ki zyada madad kaun karta hai, aur kyon?
answer: Roasted chana and an apple: body-building food, fibre and vitamins. Chips and a cold drink: lots of salt, fat and sugar with little else.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Plan a balanced breakfast for the morning of a cricket match, using foods from your home.
prompt_hi: Cricket match wali subah ke liye ghar ki cheezon se ek balanced naashta plan karo.
answer: Any breakfast with energy food (poha, paratha, roti, idli, upma), body-building food (milk, curd, egg, sprouts, dal) and protective food (fruit or vegetables), plus water.

subject: evs
prompt_en: A family on the Kerala coast eats rice, fish curry and a vegetable thoran. A family in Punjab eats roti, rajma and saag with lassi. Are both meals balanced? Explain.
prompt_hi: Kerala ke samandar kinare ek family chawal, machhli ki curry aur sabzi ka thoran khaati hai. Punjab mein ek family roti, rajma, saag aur lassi khaati hai. Kya dono meal balanced hain? Samjhao.
answer: Yes, both: rice or roti give energy; fish, rajma and lassi build the body; the vegetable thoran and saag protect. Balanced meals can look different in different places.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Here is a plate picture: half is vegetables and fruits, a quarter is roti or rice, a quarter is dal or paneer, with a glass of water. Describe in words what this plate tells us to eat.
prompt_hi: Ek plate ki picture hai: aadhi plate mein sabziyan aur phal, ek chauthai mein roti ya chawal, ek chauthai mein dal ya paneer, aur ek glass paani. Shabdon mein batao ye plate humein kya khaane ko kehti hai.
answer: Eat lots of vegetables and fruits (half the plate), some grains for energy (a quarter), some body-building food (a quarter), and drink water.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Golu says: 'Ghee and nuts have fat, so they are poison. Never eat them.' Fix Golu's idea.
prompt_hi: Golu kehta hai: 'Ghee aur nuts mein fat hota hai, toh ye zeher hain. Kabhi mat khao.' Golu ki soch theek karo.
answer: The body needs a small amount of fat for energy and growth; the problem is eating too much, like lots of fried food.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Explain to your little cousin Golu the three jobs food does in our body, with one food for each.
prompt_hi: Golu ko samjhao ki khaana humare body mein 3 kaam karta hai, har kaam ke liye ek khaane ka example dekar.
answer: Energy-giving (roti or rice) gives energy; body-building (dal, milk or paneer) helps us grow and repair; protective (fruits and vegetables) keeps us healthy and fights illness.

subject: evs
prompt_en: From last time: name two body-building foods a vegetarian child can eat.
prompt_hi: Pichhli baar se: do body-building khaane batao jo shakahari bachcha kha sakta hai.
answer: Any two of: dal, paneer, milk, curd, chana, soybean, rajma.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Give one food for each taste: sweet, salty, sour, bitter.
prompt_hi: Har swaad ke liye ek khaana batao: meetha, namkeen, khatta, kadwa.
answer: Sweet: gur or mango. Salty: namkeen or salted peanuts. Sour: lemon, imli or curd. Bitter: karela or methi seeds.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Press a potato chip on a piece of plain paper for a minute, and do the same with a slice of raw cucumber. Predict: what will you see on the paper after you lift each one and wait a while?
prompt_hi: Saade kaagaz pe ek chips ko ek minute dabao, aur phir kheere ke ek tukde ko. Guess karo: dono hata ke thodi der baad kaagaz pe kya dikhega?
answer: The chip leaves an oily, see-through spot that does not dry away; the cucumber leaves a wet spot that dries. The chips have a lot of fat (oil).

subject: evs
prompt_en: Put a few grains of sugar on the side of your tongue, not the tip. Predict first: will you taste sweet there?
prompt_hi: Cheeni ke kuch daane zubaan ke side pe rakho, tip pe nahi. Pehle guess karo: kya wahan meetha lagega?
answer: Yes: the sides of the tongue can taste sweet too; all parts of the tongue can sense all tastes.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Shake a sealed packet of chips without opening it. Predict: is the packet full of chips? What fills the rest?
prompt_hi: Chips ka band packet bina khole hilao. Guess karo: kya packet chips se bhara hai? Baaki jagah mein kya hai?
answer: No: a lot of the space is gas (nitrogen) that is put in to keep the chips fresh and stop them from breaking, so there are fewer chips than the packet size suggests.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Why is it okay to eat junk food only once in a while, not every day?
prompt_hi: Junk food kabhi-kabhi theek hai, par roz nahi. Aisa kyon?
answer: It has too much salt, sugar and fat and very little body-building or protective food; eaten often it can cause weight gain, tooth decay, tiredness and illness, and leaves less room for healthy food.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Compare a whole orange and a glass of packaged orange drink. Which keeps you full longer, and which has fibre?
prompt_hi: Ek poora santra aur ek glass packet wali orange drink ki tulna karo. Kaun zyada der tak pet bhara rakhta hai, aur kismein fibre hai?
answer: The whole orange: it has fibre, which fills you up and helps digestion; the drink has little fibre and often added sugar.

subject: evs
prompt_en: A juice pack's ingredients say: 'Water, sugar, mango pulp (10%), ...'. What is in it the most, and is it mostly fruit?
prompt_hi: Ek juice pack pe ingredients likhe hain: 'Paani, cheeni, aam ka pulp (10%), ...'. Isme sabse zyada kya hai, aur kya ye zyadatar phal hai?
answer: Mostly water, then sugar; only 10% is mango. It is mostly sugary water, not fruit.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Your class is planning snacks for a school trip. Suggest tasty swaps for chips, cold drinks and cream biscuits.
prompt_hi: Tumhari class school trip ke liye snacks plan kar rahi hai. Chips, cold drink aur cream biscuit ki jagah kuch swaadisht swap batao.
answer: e.g. roasted chana, makhana or peanuts instead of chips; nimbu paani, chaas or water instead of cold drinks; fruit or a homemade laddoo instead of cream biscuits.

subject: evs
prompt_en: This bar chart shows teaspoons of ADDED sugar: a 300 ml can of cold drink about 8, a glass of plain milk 0, a fresh orange 0. Tell me in words what the chart shows.
prompt_hi: Ye bar chart ADDED cheeni ke chammach dikhata hai: 300 ml ki ek can cold drink mein lagbhag 8, ek glass saade doodh mein 0, ek taaze santre mein 0. Shabdon mein batao chart kya keh raha hai.
answer: The cold drink has about 8 teaspoons of added sugar; plain milk and a fresh orange have no added sugar, so the cold drink adds a lot of sugar.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Golu says: 'This biscuit packet shows fresh milk and wheat fields, so it must be healthy.' Fix his thinking.
prompt_hi: Golu kehta hai: 'Is biscuit ke packet pe taaza doodh aur gehun ke khet ki photo hai, toh ye healthy hi hoga.' Uski soch theek karo.
answer: Pictures prove nothing; read the label and check the first ingredients and how much sugar, salt and fat it has.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Explain to your little cousin Golu how to tell whether a packet food is junk food.
prompt_hi: Golu ko samjhao ki kaise pata karein ki packet wala khaana junk food hai ya nahi.
answer: Read the label: if sugar, salt or fat is high and near the top of the ingredients, with little fibre or real food, it is junk; eat it only rarely and choose fresh food more.

subject: evs
prompt_en: From last time: why is a fresh fruit better than packaged juice?
prompt_hi: Pichhli baar se: taaza phal packet wale juice se behtar kyon hai?
answer: Fresh fruit has fibre and no added sugar; packaged juice often has added sugar and little fibre.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Name four feelings people can have.
prompt_hi: Chaar feelings ke naam batao jo log mehsoos karte hain.
answer: Any four, such as happy, sad, angry, scared, worried, excited, surprised, shy, proud.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Sit still and put your hand on your chest to feel your heartbeat. Then do 20 jumping jacks on a clear, open floor. Predict first: will your heartbeat be faster, slower or the same after jumping?
prompt_hi: Chupchaap baith ke seene pe haath rakho aur dhadkan mehsoos karo. Phir khuli, saaf jagah pe 20 jumping jacks karo. Pehle guess karo: jumping ke baad dhadkan tez hogi, dheemi, ya waisi hi?
answer: Faster: exercise makes the heart pump faster to send more blood and air to the working muscles.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Two children have a test the next morning. One sleeps at 9:30 pm; the other watches a phone till midnight. Predict who will remember answers better and feel fresher.
prompt_hi: Do bachchon ka agle din test hai. Ek raat 9:30 baje so jaata hai, doosra aadhi raat tak phone dekhta hai. Guess karo, kise jawab zyada yaad rahenge aur kaun fresh mehsoos karega?
answer: The one who slept at 9:30: good sleep helps the brain store what was learnt and keeps you alert.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Predict: if you watch a bright phone screen right before bed, will you fall asleep faster or slower?
prompt_hi: Guess karo: sone se theek pehle chamakti phone screen dekhoge, toh neend jaldi aayegi ya der se?
answer: Slower: bright screens and exciting videos keep the brain awake.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Why does playing outside every day help both your body and your mind?
prompt_hi: Roz bahar khelna body aur mann dono ke liye achha kyon hai?
answer: Body: muscles and bones get stronger and the heart and lungs work well. Mind: you feel happier and calmer, sleep better and make friends.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Compare how you feel in the morning after a full night's sleep and after sleeping very late. What is different?
prompt_hi: Poori neend lene ke baad subah kaisa lagta hai, aur bahut der se sone ke baad kaisa? Kya farak hai?
answer: After full sleep: fresh, energetic, able to focus. After a late night: sleepy, cranky, hard to focus, forgetful.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Your best friend didn't get picked for the cricket team and is very upset. What could you say or do to help?
prompt_hi: Tumhare best friend ka cricket team mein selection nahi hua aur woh bahut udaas hai. Tum kya keh ya kar sakte ho jisse madad ho?
answer: Listen, tell them it's okay to feel sad, stay with them or play together, remind them they can practise and try again, and suggest talking to a parent or coach.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Your dadaji says he feels stiff and tired after sitting all day. Using what you know about exercise, what would you suggest, and why?
prompt_hi: Dadaji kehte hain ki din bhar baithne se unka sharir akad jaata hai aur thakaan lagti hai. Exercise ke baare mein jo jaante ho, uske hisaab se kya suggest karoge, aur kyon?
answer: Gentle daily movement, like a walk or light yoga that his doctor says is fine, keeps the muscles and joints moving and the heart healthy, so he feels less stiff and fresher.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Here is Riya's sleep chart: Monday 10 hours, Tuesday 7, Wednesday 10, Thursday 6, Friday 10. Which days did she probably feel tired, and why?
prompt_hi: Ye Riya ka sleep chart hai: Somvaar 10 ghante, Mangalvaar 7, Budhvaar 10, Guruvaar 6, Shukravaar 10. Kis din use shayad thakaan lagi hogi, aur kyon?
answer: Tuesday and Thursday, because she slept much less than the 9 to 12 hours a child needs.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Golu says: 'If you feel sad, it means something is wrong with you. Good children are always happy.' What's wrong with that?
prompt_hi: Golu kehta hai: 'Agar tum udaas ho, toh tumme kuch gadbad hai. Achhe bachche hamesha khush rehte hain.' Isme kya galat hai?
answer: Everyone feels sad sometimes; it is normal and it passes. Talking to someone you trust helps.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Explain to your little cousin Golu why he should go to bed on time. Give two reasons.
prompt_hi: Golu ko samjhao ki use time pe kyon sona chahiye. Do kaaran do.
answer: While we sleep the body grows and repairs and the brain stores what we learnt; with enough sleep we feel fresh and can play and learn better.

subject: evs
prompt_en: From last time: when you feel worried, who are two people you could talk to?
prompt_hi: Pichhli baar se: jab tumhe chinta ho, toh kin do logon se baat kar sakte ho?
answer: Any two trusted people, such as a parent, a grandparent, an older brother or sister, a class teacher or a good friend.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Name three people whose work helps a roti reach your plate.
prompt_hi: 3 logon ke naam batao jinki mehnat se roti tumhari thali tak pahunchti hai.
answer: Any three: farmer, farm labourer, truck driver, shopkeeper, chakki-wala (miller), the person who cooks.

subject: evs
prompt_en: A wheat field needs a lot of water to grow. Predict: if we throw away one roti, what else gets wasted besides the roti?
prompt_hi: Gehun ke khet ko ugne mein bahut paani lagta hai. Guess karo: agar hum ek roti phenk dein, toh roti ke alawa aur kya-kya bekaar jaata hai?
answer: The water, soil and seeds used to grow the wheat, the farmer's work, the fuel used to transport and grind it, and the gas and effort used to cook it.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Mix a handful of wheat or rice grains with some tiny dry bits of paper on a plate. Gently blow across the plate. Predict first: what will fly off and what will stay?
prompt_hi: Ek plate mein mutthi bhar gehun ya chawal ke daane aur kaagaz ke bahut chhote sookhe tukde mila do. Plate ke upar se dheere se phoonko. Pehle guess karo: kya ud jayega aur kya rahega?
answer: The light paper bits fly off and the heavier grains stay; farmers separate light husk from grain with wind in the same way (winnowing).

subject: evs
prompt_en: Why do farmers thresh and winnow wheat after harvesting it?
prompt_hi: Fasal kaatne ke baad kisaan gehun ko thresh aur winnow (phatakna) kyon karte hain?
answer: Threshing separates the grains from the stalks and ears; winnowing uses wind to blow away the light husk so only clean grain is left.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Two leftovers: (A) rice cooked last night, cooled and kept covered in the fridge; (B) dal left on the kitchen counter for two hot days that smells sour. Which can be used, and why?
prompt_hi: Do bache hue khaane: (A) kal raat ka chawal, thanda karke dhak ke fridge mein rakha; (B) do garam din tak counter pe padi dal jisme khatti badboo hai. Kaunsa use kar sakte hain, aur kyon?
answer: A can be used soon (stored safely; heat it well). B has spoiled and must not be eaten.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Rice also travels from field to plate. Fill in the missing step: paddy is grown → harvested → threshed → ___ (husk removed) → packed → cooked.
prompt_hi: Chawal bhi khet se thali tak aata hai. Khaali step bharo: dhaan ugaaya → kaata → daane alag kiye → ___ (chhilka hataaya) → pack kiya → pakaaya.
answer: Milling at a rice mill, where the husk is removed.

subject: evs
prompt_en: At a big wedding feast lots of food gets left over. Suggest two good ways to stop it going to waste.
prompt_hi: Badi shaadi ki daawat mein bahut khaana bach jaata hai. Ise bekaar hone se bachaane ke do achhe tareeke batao.
answer: Any two: serve smaller helpings and let people take only what they can eat; with adults, safely share good untouched food with others (food-sharing groups); compost peels and scraps.

subject: evs
prompt_en: Look at this picture strip of six boxes: seeds in soil, green plants, golden plants being cut, grains being separated, a chakki, a roti on a tawa. Tell the story of the roti in words.
prompt_hi: Ye chhe dabbon wali picture strip dekho: mitti mein beej, hare paudhe, sunehri fasal ki katai, daane alag hote hue, chakki, tawe pe roti. Roti ki kahani shabdon mein sunao.
answer: Seeds were sown, they grew into wheat plants, the ripe wheat was harvested, the grains were separated by threshing, ground into atta at the chakki, and the atta was made into roti.
